items.title: Trump Blasts Chevron CEO Over High Gas Prices
items.summary: President Trump has taken to Truth Social to lambast Chevron CEO Mike Wirth, blaming oil companies for gasoline prices, which remain above $4 a gallon.  Reacting to Wirth's appearance on Fox News with Maria Bartiromo, Trump said the CEO hadn't credited his administration for the oil industry's good fortunes.
